54GUC - third-party software notices

The component list and the purpose of each component are in
open_source_manifest.json and the application's VERSION dialog. These notices
are separate from the project licence in LICENSE. Each third-party component
retains its own copyright, licence and warranty terms.

Original pinned distribution notices are in _internal/licenses. inventory.json
records their component versions, source and SHA-256. GNU LGPLv3 and GPLv3
texts are included for Qt/PySide/Shiboken. The open-source LGPL option is used;
the commercial licence reference in upstream metadata does not indicate a
commercial Qt licence purchase. Qt Virtual Keyboard is not used or distributed.

Qt/PySide/Shiboken are dynamically loaded, unmodified upstream libraries.
Their licences permit modification, replacement and reverse engineering for
debugging modifications to those libraries; 54GUC terms do not restrict these
rights. Use ABI-compatible replacement libraries in _internal/PySide6 and
_internal/shiboken6; keep a separate copy of the original application first.
The Qt Windows platform plugin must remain compatible with its Qt libraries.

Matching upstream source:
https://code.qt.io/cgit/qt/qt5.git/tag/?h=v6.11.1
https://code.qt.io/cgit/pyside/pyside-setup.git/tag/?h=v6.11.1
https://www.python.org/downloads/source/

Public release preparation must provide equivalent access to matching LGPL
source archives and any required installation information alongside the binary.
Upstream links and included notices alone are not a completed public-release
licence audit. Contact: 54guc2026@protonmail.com.
